brokers.name: BH2 broker :5672
brokers.responsibility: BH2 help-run transport, on the shared workflow-kit emulator
brokers.runtime_note: BH2's queue is created at runtime and is not in the emulator's startup config, so an emulator restart does not restore it (handoff OPERATIONS.md:101).
brokers.identity_basis: bh2-broker-help.py:31-36 uses Explorer's connection string with the host swapped to 127.0.0.1, which is port 5672; workflow-kit docker-compose.yml:26 publishes 5672.

brokers.name: Washplant broker :5673
brokers.responsibility: Washplant work transport, on its own emulator
brokers.identity_basis: washplant/DECISIONS.md:5 and docker-compose.yml:1 declare its own emulator, so restart tests cannot touch the shared one. It is not a replacement for BH2's broker.

explorer.identity_basis: washplant-sb-explorer runs on network washplant_default with sb://washplant-sb-emulator (:5673); bh2-servicebus-explorer attaches to workflowkit-servicebus-emulator (:5672).
